name: Bandwagon 5 (Dedicated Mid-Inclination Rideshare)
slot_a_text: This is the 19th flight for B1085. It is aiming for the drone ship A Shortfall of Gravitas, 600 km downrange. It last flew Starlink Group 10-19 about 2 months ago.
slot_b_text: SpaceX's 121st launch of the year, 740th all time. That is a launch every other day. No Falcon 9 has failed in 342 flights. Worldwide, it is attempt number 244 of the year.
description: Dedicated rideshare flight to a mid-inclination orbit with dozens of small microsatellites and nanosatellites for commercial and government customers. This launch also carries the second demonstration mission for SpaceX’s Project Starfall, which aims to mass-produce reentry capsules designed to autonomously transport valuable customer experiments and other payloads safely back from space to Earth, including for in-orbit manufacturing.
rocket_fact: Specific impulse (Isp) is a measure of rocket-engine efficiency, roughly analogous to fuel economy for a car.
